subject: Prospect releases demo slot as product priorities shift
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orinco.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <n.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tharris@orinco.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo slot next Tuesday

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the reminder about next Tuesday. I need to ask that you release the slot — we just had a product meeting and the team is being pulled onto an analytics sprint that starts next week. The inference pilot is being deprioritized for now and we won’t have bandwidth to run the POC through June.

Can you release the calendar invite and keep any materials you’ve already shared on file? We’d still like to keep the conversation open and aim to revisit this in Q4 when priorities settle down.

If you have a short checklist or a recording of the planned demo, please send it; that would help our newly-assigned PMs stay caught up without blocking them to attend live sessions.

Appreciate your flexibility — I’m copying Tom who will own the re-evaluation when the team cycles back.

Best,
Elena Soto
Senior Product Lead — Orinco Systems

--
Attachments: none
From: Nikhil Sharma <n.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orinco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Harris <tharris@orinco.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo slot next Tuesday

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for the context. Totally understand the need to redirect resources.

Action items from our side:
- I’ll release the calendar invite and mark the slot as available.
- I’m attaching a short \"Inference evaluation checklist\" (one page) and the mutual action plan draft so your team can pick up later without us needing to run a live session.
- I’ll also send a recording of the demo and a one-page performance/cost summary for the model configurations we discussed.

When you’re ready to re-engage, please use my calendar link (below) or loop Tom in and we’ll prioritize rebooking. I’ll leave the deal in a deferred state (Q4 follow-up suggested) and flag any open technical questions so they don’t fall through the cracks.

Thanks again — we’re here to help when the timing is right.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Calendly: https://calendly.com/nsharma/30min

Camila / Marissa,

FYI — Orinco has deprioritized the inference pilot for the next few months and asked us to release the demo slot. I sent the checklist and MAP to keep the conversation warm.

Suggested internal follow-ups:
- Move deal ORC-4521 to \"Deferred — re-evaluate Q4\" in HubSpot and note reason: product priorities shifted to analytics.
- Add a 90-day outbound task for AE and an account health check for CS.
- Keep the MAP in the deal record so the new PM can pick up quickly.

This looks like a timing-driven deprioritization (not a technical rejection). I’d recommend we keep them on the content drip: product notes, a 3-min ROI summary, and the recording.

Thanks,
Nikhil
